patterns.name: ENV
patterns.message: Potential leak of sensitive data in Terraform environment variable (TF_VAR_).

patterns.name: Cloudflare API Token
patterns.message: Cloudflare API Token detected. Please remove it from the code and use environment variables or secret management tools to store sensitive information securely.

patterns.name: Cloudflare Account/Zone ID (.env)
patterns.message: Cloudflare Account ID or Zone ID detected. Please remove it from the code and use environment variables or secret management tools to store sensitive information securely.

patterns.name: Hardcoded Cloudflare Account/Zone ID (Terraform)
patterns.message: Hardcoded Cloudflare account_id/zone_id detected in Terraform code. Please reference var.cloudflare_account_id / var.cloudflare_zone_id instead of hardcoding the value.
